title: format_histogram on empty Stats raises ZeroDivisionError
property: format_histogram does not crash on an empty dataset, which Stats supports (default value)
expected: a string (or a clear documented error)
actual: ZeroDivisionError: float division by zero at line_k = float(bar_cols) / count_max (count_max == 0)
evidence: Stats has a `default` for empty data and get_quantile/describe handle empty data; get_histogram_counts explicitly handles empty data by returning [(0.0, 0)] (_get_bin_bounds returns [0.0]), but format_histogram_counts divides by the max count, which is 0.
